turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
What would you want me to say to Owen tomorrow?
You're asking me how to do your job, Hale? Tomorrow you tell him the zero is coming off. Now, on what basis did you enter it?
Like the actual words. Write it out for me and I'll read it to him.
Write your own words, Hale. My terms are the zero withdrawn, an apology to Owen, and nothing on his record. You still haven't told me who decided this.
